description: Validates context-aware AI payload building across selection, marks, single segment, and full transcript scopes

segments.text: Welcome to our lecture on artificial intelligence systems.
We start with stochastic gradient descent and momentum optimization.
Convolutional networks excel at visual feature representations.
Attention mechanisms allow transformers to process entire sequences in parallel.
In conclusion, modern models scale with compute and parameter size.

aiContextTests.name: Selection scope with 'summarize' action
expectedMustContain: Summarize the following transcript excerpt in concise, high-impact bullet points:
[01:25] We start with stochastic gradient descent

aiContextTests.name: Marks scope with 'explain' action
expectedMustContain: Explain the key concepts and arguments discussed in this excerpt
[03:40] Convolutional networks excel at visual feature representations.

aiContextTests.name: Single segment scope with 'action_items' action
expectedMustContain: Extract all actionable steps, recommendations, and key takeaways

aiContextTests.name: Full scope with custom prompt directive
aiContextTests.customPrompt: Generate 3 study flashcards from this lecture:
expectedMustContain: Generate 3 study flashcards from this lecture:
[00:10] Welcome to our lecture on artificial intelligence systems.
[09:50] In conclusion, modern models scale with compute and parameter size.
